key_insight: Training only on minimal corrections at the first reasoning failure improves instruction compliance while largely preserving untargeted skills.
engineering_relevance: Localized supervision offers a way to shape LLM reasoning behavior without forcing imitation of entire demonstrations.
method: Sample a model completion and identify its first failure under a specified criterion.
Propose a minimal replacement span and supervise only the edited text.
Apply corrections offline or online to track evolving failure modes.
evidence_signal: On ReasonIF with Qwen3-32B, edit-based training substantially improved reasoning-instruction compliance versus full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning, while largely preserving untargeted skills.
watch_item: Effectiveness depends on the editor accurately locating the first failure and producing a valid minimal correction.
paper_title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
